links.outcome: Variance in LLM clinical note summaries across paraphrased instruction prompts
links.effect: Instruction prompts increased performance variance, producing significantly distinct summaries even when prompts share similar meanings. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: However, we show that this approach also leads to increased performance variance, resulting in significantly distinct summaries even when instruction prompts share similar meanings.

unlisted_practices: Soft prompt-based calibration (SPeC) to reduce LLM output variance in clinical note summarization

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a prompt calibration technique (SPeC) aimed at reducing performance variability and inconsistency when summarizing clinical notes using LLMs across benchmark datasets.

primary.practice: soft prompt-based calibration to reduce output variance
